newsitem.title: INDIA: India Rayon has 400-mln-rupee bond issue.
newsitem.headline: India Rayon has 400-mln-rupee bond issue.

text.p: Indian Rayon and Industries Ltd said on Monday it had raised 400 million rupees through a private placement of secured redeemable non-convertible debentures at a coupon rate of 14.5 percent.
"Indian Rayon is the first private sector corporation to have raised 400 million rupees through the private placement..." the firm said in a statement.

"Indian Rayon has set a new trend which will be a benchmark for long term corporate papers in the domestic market," it added. "Till date most 'AAA'-rated debentures with a five-year maturity period have been placed at 14.50 to 14.75 percent coupon."
The firm said the money would fund a modernisation programme at its plants.

"To continue to maintain its leading edge in the sectors in which it operates such as viscose filament yarn, cement, carbon black, insulators, it has embarked on projects entailing capital expenditure of over 3.2 billion rupees for the next two years."
Birla Global Finance Ltd, DSP Merrill Lynch and Credit Lyonnaise were the arrangers to the issue, which was 100 percent oversubscribed, the firm said.
